resources.string: A short tour of the main screens
Skip — I know my way around
You can always reopen this guide in Settings.
Follow the guide in order, or skip it and return later.
The main sections are at the bottom; numbers in the examples show where to tap.
Prayer is your home screen: times, prayer marks, Quran and everyday tools.
Limits helps you manage time in selected apps; enabling limits is optional.
Settings contains city, language, appearance and this guide.
Start with your city and check the timetable source.
Tap the city on the home screen and choose your location.
In prayer time settings, check the source and options for your region.
Open Adhan and alerts to choose reminders and sound.
Unmarked does not mean missed: you choose the prayer status.
After praying, tick the box beside the prayer on the home screen.
Open Prayer history to browse days and edit earlier marks.
Mark a missed prayer in the history, then choose Made up after making it up.
Surahs, translation, saved ayahs and personal reading statistics.
Tap Read Quran on the home screen, choose a surah and a comfortable reading view.
Press and hold an ayah to bookmark it; find it later in Bookmarks.
Press and hold to add a note; the ayah will remain marked when you return.
One shared daily allowance for all selected apps.
In Limits, choose the apps you want to limit and tap Done.
Set a shared daily allowance in limit settings; every selected app uses this same time.
Grant the required permissions and turn on Limit app time; blocking needs both.
These permissions enable app limits; notification permission is separate.
Open Set up phone permissions and allow usage access to measure time in apps.
Choose one blocking method: display over other apps or the ZikrTime accessibility service.
Return to the app, tap Done and check the protection status in Limits.
You can use Knowledge without enabling app limits.
Choose your knowledge level on your first visit; it determines question difficulty.
Tap Answer questions, study the material and complete a round; earned bonuses add time in Limits.
Tap Review what you learned to revisit the material and practise.
Find Where to pray in Settings; search by name or address.
Move the map with one finger; the location button finds places near you.
Tap a mosque marker or card, then Details to read all available information.
Tap Directions to open the route to your chosen place in a maps app.
Qibla and Tasbih are available from the home screen and Settings.
In Qibla, turn your phone following the direction indicator; the camera is not needed.
Tap Reminders on the home screen to set up bedtime and Friday reading.
Shop contains listings for companies, products and services.
Browse Our partners or use search to find what you need.
Open a seller card and choose an available contact option to ask about a purchase.
Add your company opens the Telegram cabinet; fill in your listing and submit it for review.
